name: Andrew M. Byrd
specializations: Historical Phonology, Proto-Indo-European, and Constructed Languages
statement: My primary research focus is the creation and application of innovative approaches to solve difficult problems in historical linguistics.
I also work to educate the public about Proto-Indo-European (PIE) and historical linguistics through constructed languages and other forms of outreach.

details: 2<sup>nd</sup> place, “Best Dissertation of 2011 in the field of Indo-European,” Indogermanische Gesellschaft

education.degree: BA, Linguistics (minors: Latin, German, and Italian)

projects.name: DERBi PIE
projects.description: A searchable database of the PIE language (Database of Etymological Roots Beginning in PIE), which includes multiple etymological reference works and search functions.

projects.name: Immersive Proto-Indo-European
projects.description: With Brenna Reinhart Byrd, a textbook and four novellas that introduce the Proto-Indo-European language and archaeology through engaging, immersive stories.
